game_start.intro: Egwuregwu ahụ na-amalite. Trump uwe: {trump_suit} (kaadị trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na German Whist. {phase_info} I jide {hand_size} kaadị. Gwuo kaadị na '[play N]', ebe N bụ ọnọdụ ya n'aka gị (dịka ọmụmaatụ '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Enweghị kaadị a na-enye - usoro egwuregwu amalitela.
next_card.deck_empty: The deck is empty - no card is on offer.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ọkpụkpọ na-abaghị uru. Jiri '[play N]' iji kpọọ kaadị Nth n'aka gị.
invalid_move.bad_position: Ọnọdụ kaadị ahụ adịghị adị. Ị na-ejide kaadị {hand_size}.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: Ị ga-eso ya ma kpọọ kaadị {lead_suit}.

trick.won: Onye na-egwu {winner_id} na-emeri aghụghọ ahụ na {card}.
trick.won_learning: Onye na-egwu egwu {winner_id} na-emeri aghụghọ ahụ na {card} ma were kaadị ihu elu.

phase.learning_complete: Ihe niile dị n'ime deck ahụ agwụla. Oge mmụta agwụla - aghụghọ ọ bụla fọdụrụnụ na-emetụta mmeri.

draw.winner_received: I meriri aghụghọ ahụ ma nata {card}.
draw.loser_received: Ị tufuru aghụghọ ahụ ma dọpụta {card} site na oche.

turn.scores_learning: Ndị meriri ruo ugbu a - Onye ọkpụkpọ 0: {tricks0}, Onye ọkpụkpọ 1: {tricks1}
turn.phase_learning: Oge: {phase} ({remaining_cards} kaadị ndị fọdụrụ na oche)

trick_view.empty: Enweghi kaadị egwuri egwu ma aghụghọ a.

board_str.player_line: {observation} Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id}: {scoring} na-eme atụmatụ ({tricks} ngụkọta), {hand_size} kaadị n'aka
